name: file-toolbox-electron
description: File Toolbox - Electron + Python 桌面应用

scripts.dev:main: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && electron . --user-data-dir=.dev-user-data
scripts.dev: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && concurrently "vite --config vite.renderer.config.ts" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron . --user-data-dir=.dev-user-data"
scripts.build:main: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.package:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
